Trump to attend Theodore Roosevelt library opening amid policy contrasts

Donald Trump is scheduled to attend the opening of the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. His attendance comes as critics note a contrast between Roosevelt's conservation efforts and Trump's administration's actions on land protection. The event highlights differing approaches to environmental legacy.
